full_judgment: 15. The trial court decreed the suit in favour of the plaintiffs on the findings that the Bainanama was genuine and valid and passed consideration but disbelieved the agreement executed on 8-3-1981 (Exhibit-2) for Taka 20,000 (Twenty thousand) and found that same was collusive and created one. The learned trial court further found that the suit is not barred by limitation. Appellate court affirming the judgment of the trial court found that the plaintiffs are entitled to get a decree for Specific Performance of Contract.
